summary: The DocumentTypeConversion class provides methods to convert MIME content types into more readable document type names. It handles several common document and image formats, mapping them to user-friendly names.
purpose: To provide a human-readable document type name based on the MIME content type of a file.

workflows.name: Convert MIME Type to Friendly Document Type
steps: Define the GetFriendlyDocumentType method that takes a ContentType string as input.
Using a switch statement, match the ContentType against known MIME types.
Return a user-friendly document type string from Resources based on the matched MIME type.
Return a default 'Unknown' type if no match is found.
